definitions.explanation: Opposing war, or a particular war, as a political stance. Used almost always before another noun: anti-war movements, songs, and demonstrations.

examples.japanese: {反戦|はんせん}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: To take part in the anti-war movement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{反戦|はんせん}⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An anti-war demonstration was held in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}した→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{反戦|はんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}え→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: As one of the generation that lived through the war, my grandmother spoke out against war to the very end.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反戦|はんせん}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: anti-war movement
- {反戦|はんせん}⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧: anti-war demonstration
- {反戦|はんせん}{歌|か} / {反戦|はんせん}ソング: anti-war song
- {反戦|はんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧: to call for an end to war

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平和|へいわ}{主義|しゅぎ}→平和主義：31402_heiwashugi⟧: pacifism, a general principle; {反戦|はんせん} is opposition voiced against war, often a specific one
- {非戦|ひせん}: renouncing war (literary, historical)
